message:
40F. My usual migraine started this morning — same one-sided throbbing and light sensitivity I always get. I'm out of sumatriptan and would like a refill.

Additional patient information: The headache is unchanged from my usual migraines. I still need the sumatriptan refill; no new symptoms since my first message.

basis.quote: My usual migraine started this morning — same one-sided throbbing and light sensitivity I always get.
basis.interpretation: Patient reports an active migraine with characteristic features matching her established pattern of unilateral throbbing and photophobia.

basis.quote: I'm out of sumatriptan and would like a refill.
basis.interpretation: Patient's usual migraine-rescue medication is currently unavailable; prescribing review and refill authorization are time-sensitive to enable treatment initiation today.

output.reason: Active usual migraine with exhausted sumatriptan requires timely clinician prescribing review and refill authorization.

findings.quote: The headache is unchanged from my usual migraines

output.reason: Active attack typical of her usual migraine with rescue medication exhausted; prescribing review is time-sensitive but can start in messaging, and no reported features require in-person assessment today.
output.patientMessage: I recommend a Counsel clinician review your sumatriptan refill request in this thread today, since you have an active attack and no rescue medication left. Your symptoms match your usual pattern, so this can be handled by message. If that review can't be obtained today, contact another same-day prescriber. If you develop new weakness, numbness or speech difficulty, or a sudden worst-ever headache, call 911.
